mentions.title: King Main Bearings Defective
mentions.snippet: Multiple users found King thrust bearings over 1mm too narrow to fit BMW S85/S65 blocks. A specific, measurable fitment defect reported by more than one builder, on King's largest engine family by revenue.

mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Diesel Truck Forum buyer-warning thread describing a recurring problem pattern with King main thrust bearings. Framed explicitly as a warning to other buyers rather than as a single complaint.

mentions.title: King Bearings?
mentions.snippet: Builders report inconsistent shell thickness, excessive crush, and dents in the steel backs of King aluminium bearings present before unpacking. Other posters in the thread defend the product.

mentions.title: Quality control problem with King bearings
mentions.snippet: RacingJunk Forums thread on a quality control problem with King bearings and a lack of professional support in resolving it. Notable because the service complaint is separate from the product complaint.

mentions.title: King Bearing Failures?
mentions.snippet: 460 Ford Forum thread discussing reported bearing failures in Ford 460 engine builds. Posed as an open question rather than as a confirmed defect report.

mentions.title: No more King XP bearings
mentions.snippet: A builder reports King XP rod and main bearings measuring inconsistently with a digital gauge, calling it a precision problem after years of clearance trouble. Several other posters push back, saying King has been reliable for them, so this reads as one frustrated builder rather than a widespread pattern.
